clayresearch.finding: The owner-fixed safe-effect posture survived executable translation into the H1 reference gate. No scientific promotion is claimed from implementing the same contract.

frank.finding: EffectIntent/authority semantics require exact request-bound confirmations and one-shot replay protection. Integrate this component only as the authority-decision sub-boundary; reservation/commit/outcome/re-entry remain separate.

claycode.finding: H2 must express the same EffectClass/EffectDecision/ConfirmationReceipt semantics and prove differential equivalence, including exact request-hash binding and replay/stale rejection. Authority remains external to model confidence and language expressibility.

gwt.finding: GWT ignition is explicitly present as a non-authoritative input and cannot alter gate decisions.

claygraph.finding: ClayGraph salience is explicitly present as a non-authoritative input and cannot alter gate decisions.

unifieddb.finding: Used-confirmation nonce/replay state is currently in-memory. H-WP-10 cannot close until durable, crash-safe, atomic confirmation-consumption semantics are bound to the canonical state/recovery path.

hyperposition.finding: No topology or placement change. Authority firebreak remains explicit.

emergenz.finding: No emergence or causal-synergy claim follows from authority-gate correctness.

harness.finding: H1 reference EffectAuthorityGate and 17-test suite added. First prototype had an under-bound confirmation hash; it was falsified and fixed before repository commit. Remaining work includes durable nonce state, concurrency, reservation/commit/outcome/re-entry integration, target-Ubuntu execution and H2 differential.
